connection_policy.reason: internal lane geometry is postprocessed against the UE RoadWay mesh so SUMO turns stay on the visual drivable surface

direction_policy.direction_1: road-level default_flow is GeoJSON point order; only used when no stronger valid lane-level separator is available
direction_policy.direction_2: road-level default_flow is bidirectional; valid YellowLine separators refine lane groups when present but are not required for bidirectional default
direction_policy.direction_4: road-level default_flow is reverse GeoJSON point order; only used when no stronger valid lane-level separator is available
direction_policy.separator_required: isolation=2 with lanes>=2 and direction!=2 requires valid separator resolution; unresolved roads are explicitly audited/discarded instead of silently exporting all lanes as direction default
direction_policy.valid_yellow_separator: lane-level direction authority only after corridor projection, lateral offset, road main-body coverage, lateral stability, road-end buffer, and ambiguity checks pass

invalidated_legacy_outputs: legacy SUMO output generated from the old net
Dataset/render_ready_episodes generated from the old SUMO net
Dataset/render_ready_episodes_capture_filtered generated from the old SUMO net
lane_policy: one physical lane centerline per directed SUMO edge unless generated geometry is explicitly discarded by a documented geometry guard; abrupt Z-layer jumps and SideWalk top-surface samples are lane-level discards before SUMO edge export; painted road markings are allowed as top surface samples; valid YellowLine splits use road.width/road.lanes canonical lane offsets rather than guessing lane groups from RoadWay cross-section widths

pedestrian_policy.pedestrian_routes_source: existing pedestrian/semantic generator, not SUMO road net

discard_history.policy: do not fall back to all-forward direction for isolation=2 lanes>=2 direction!=2 roads
f/r lane groups must participate in lane-to-lane connections; disconnected groups are audited/discarded instead of exporting unusable directed lanes

discard_policy.reason: source roads are removed when UE drivable material is fragmented, required lane separators are unresolved, generated lane samples leave the drivable RoadWay/road-marking union, or f/r lane groups cannot connect in SUMO

roadway_mesh.drivable_component_policy: only BP_CityBaseGenerator Road component contributes vehicle drivable geometry; Ground/Terrain/Water are excluded even if old exports label them RoadWay
roadway_mesh.lane_top_surface_policy: generated lanes are audited against the top Road-component UE mesh material inside a 2.0m lane-center footprint; lanes are discarded before SUMO edge export only when SideWalk occupies enough footprint stations to indicate the lane itself is on sidewalk, while adjacent sidewalk and painted road markings such as WhiteLine/YellowLine are accepted

traffic_light_policy.rule: node has at least two incoming motorized approaches, directed physical-lane graph degree >= 3, and an incident road has func_level <= 2 or manage_level <= 3
